Container.Name: Wolfenstein3D
Container.Overview:
id Software's Wolfenstein 3-D, from its 1995 source release, ported to 64-bit Linux and playable in a browser.
The container runs its own X server (Xvfb) and exports it over noVNC, so nothing needs to be installed on the host.
Sound comes out of the browser, with nothing to set up: the AdLib music and effects, emulated, and the Sound Blaster's digitized voices are mixed inside the container and sent to the same page as the picture, over the WebUI port. Click to start playing and the sound starts with it, because browsers will not play audio without a click.
The shareware episode is included, so this plays as soon as it starts - episode 1, ten levels. To play all six episodes, put the files from your own copy of the game (VSWAP.WL6 and the rest) into the Game data folder below and they will be used instead. Spear of Destiny (*.SOD), its mission packs (*.SD2, *.SD3) and its demo (*.SDM) work too; with several there, Settings - Game in the game switches between them. Names are matched without regard to case. The registered game is not included and must come from your own copy.
The WebUI opens a client that captures the mouse. Escape hands the cursor back, and the ` key opens the game menu. A game controller works too, on a phone as well as a desktop, and vibrates when you are hit.
Container.Requires: Nothing. The shareware episode ships with the container. Add your own game's files to the Game data folder to play the full game.
Container.Changes:
### 1.5.0 - A resolution under Settings - Picture, 320x240 to 1920x1440, changeable while playing in the browser. - The main menu's Sound and Change View are gone: they are Settings' Sound and Picture pages (F4, F5).
### 1.4.0 - A full-screen view, as DOOM's: the whole width above the status bar, no border. New players start with it.
### 1.3.0 - The view starts at its largest, and its size is under Settings - Picture. - Backspace opens the menu and backs out of it, as Esc does.
### 1.2.0 - Every setting in one Settings menu (main menu, F4, F6 or F12): game, picture, sound devices and levels, every key, the mouse and its buttons.
### 1.1.0 - Keys to strafe left and right (, and . by default), rebound under Settings - Keys. - New Game asks which game to play when there is more than one.
### 1.0.0 - First release: the 1995 source release ported to 64-bit Linux, the shareware episode built in, playable in a browser with sound and a controller. - Spear of Destiny, its mission packs and its demo, from your own copy. - In-game Settings (main menu or F12): game, picture shape, music and effects levels, mouse and controller.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the browser client, carrying the picture, the sound and the controller. Open the WebUI to play.

Config.Name: VNC Port
Config.Description: Optional. Only needed if you want to connect with a native VNC client instead of the browser.

Config.Name: Game data
Config.Description: Optional. The shareware episode is already in the container. Put the files of your own copy of the game here - VSWAP.WL6, VGAGRAPH.WL6 and the rest, or the .WL3 files of the three-episode version - to play the full game. Mounted read only; the container never writes to it.

Config.Name: Saves and config
Config.Description: Savegames, settings, high scores and the container's logs.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID the game runs as. Must be able to write the saves folder. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID the game runs as. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: Scale
Config.Description: The resolution to begin with, 1 to 6: the picture is 320x200 multiplied by this, so 2 gives 640x400. The game's Settings - Picture changes it while playing. Larger values are sharper and cost more bandwidth to the browser.

Config.Name: Game
Config.Description: Which game to play when the Game data folder holds several: wl6, sod, sd2, sd3, sdm or wl1. Empty: the one last chosen in the game's Settings, or the first found.

Config.Name: Sound
Config.Description: Set to 0 for no sound at all, which saves the bandwidth the audio stream uses.

Config.Name: Restart on crash
Config.Description: Start the game again if it crashes or you quit it, leaving the container up so the browser reconnects on its own. Set to 0 to have the container stop instead.

Config.Name: VNC Password
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the browser and any VNC client must supply this password. Leave empty for no password, which is fine on a LAN you trust.

Config.Name: Audio rate
Config.Description: Rate the sound reaches the browser at, in Hz. 22050 is the default and costs about 700 kbit/s. Use 11025 to halve that, or 44100 to double it.

Config.Name: PulseAudio server
Config.Description: Optional, and not what most people want. Leave empty and the sound goes to the browser. Set this to a reachable PulseAudio server, for example tcp:192.168.1.50:4713, and the sound goes there instead - to speakers attached to that machine, not to yours.
